newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy fuel consumption by generating sector falls.
newsitem.headline: Italy fuel consumption by generating sector falls.

text.p: Consumption of fuel oil by Italy's power generating sector fell 14.3 percent to 6.95 million tonnes in the first four months of 1997, data from trade group Unione Petrolifera (UP) showed.
UP said in a statement that in the January-April period total consumption of petroleum products was down 5.5 percent on the same period last year to 30.74 million tonnes.
In April, total consumption of petroleum products rose, after eight consecutive months of decline, by 3.5 percent year-on-year to 7.6 million tonnes.
But April demand for fuel oil for use by the power generating sector fell 1.4 percent to 1.73 million tonnes.

UP data showed that one percent sulphur fuel oil accounted for 1.47 million tonnes in April, a 2.3 percent rise on April 1996, but in the January-April period posted a fall of 11.5 percent to 5.50 million tonnes. -- Milan newsroom +392 66129589
